text: Whereas, In the opinion of the Government of the United States
the coming of Chinese laborers to this country endangers the good order of certain
localities within the territory thereof: Therefore, Be it enacted by
the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in
Congress assembled, That from and after the expiration of ninety days next
after the passage of this act, and until the expiration of ten years next after
the passage of this act, the coming of Chinese laborers to the United States be,
and the same is hereby, suspended; and during such sus=

to come, or, having so come after the expiration of said
ninety days, to remain within the United States.
